definitions.explanation: Allowing some light to pass through but not fully transparent. Objects behind a translucent material can be vaguely seen but not clearly.

examples.japanese: {半透明|はんとうめい}のガラスを{使|つか}った。
{半透明|はんとうめい}のカーテンで{光|ひかり}を{柔|やわ}らかくする。
examples.english: To soften the light with translucent curtains.

examples.japanese: このプラスチック{容器|ようき}は{半透明|はんとうめい}なので、{中身|なかみ}がうっすら{見|み}える。
examples.english: This plastic container is translucent, so the contents are faintly visible.

notes:
{半透明|はんとうめい} describes something that lets some light through but is not fully see-through. Objects behind it appear blurry or indistinct.

WORD FORMATION:
{半|はん} (half, semi-) + {透明|とうめい} (transparent).

FORMS:
Used as both a noun and a な-adjective: {半透明|はんとうめい}な{素材|そざい} (translucent material).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半透明|はんとうめい}のガラス: frosted/translucent glass
- {半透明|はんとうめい}のフィルム: translucent film
- {半透明|はんとうめい}の{容器|ようき}: translucent container
- {半透明|はんとうめい}な{素材|そざい}: translucent material

CONTRAST:
- {透明|とうめい}: transparent (fully see-through)
- {半透明|はんとうめい}: translucent (partially see-through)
- {不透明|ふとうめい}: opaque (not see-through); also figuratively means "unclear, uncertain"
